$$\log G(n+a) = \frac{n^2}{2}\log n - \frac{3n^2}{4} + \alpha\, n\log n + \left(-\alpha + \tfrac{1}{2}\log 2\pi\right)n + \left(\tfrac{\alpha^2}{2} - \tfrac{1}{12}\right)\log n + \tfrac{\alpha}{2}\log 2\pi + \zeta'(-1) + O(1/n).$$
